fresh_leads.title: 2027 Data Scientist Summer Internship
fresh_leads.qualification_text: 2027 Data Scientist Summer Internship New York, United States Campus Full time Lazard is one of the world's preeminent financial advisory and asset management firms. Our people and culture make the difference . While global in presence and reach, ours is a close, collaborative community of just over 3,000 professionals. Lazard is a place of continuous knowledge sharing, skill development and relationship building, where professionals grow and succeed together. Our entrepreneurial culture, flat structure and embrace of individual differences, allow creative ideas, original concepts, and unique perspectives to drive our business forward — and for careers to take flight. The Lazard AI and Data Group brings together data scientists, data engineers, AI engineers, and software engineers to develop advanced AI and data-driven solutions that enhance decision-making across Lazard's Financial Advisory and Asset Management businesses. The team delivers practical insights and technology that support client engagements, strengthen strategic partnerships, and help the firm remain competitive and efficient in a rapidly evolving financial landscape. Operating as Lazard's internal innovation engine, the group identifies opportunities to improve business processes through technology and develops solutions from end to end—from concept development and design through deployment, performance analysis, and continuous iteration. The Data Scientist Summer Intern at Lazard will work within the AI & Data Team. The primary responsibility is to help analyze large-scale data sets in finance and extract insights that add value to the busines s. The Data Science Summer Intern will have the opportunity to work closely with data scientists, investment bankers, portfolio managers and senior management across the Firm. We're all-in on the cloud and are a leader in the adoption of new technologies. Successful candidates should have a strong quantitative background, including solid statistical modeling skills and hands-on programming experience. Eligibility Criteria: Ability to start internship June 7, 2027 and end August 13, 2027 Ability to be in NYC for the duration of the internship In addition to above, we will also need to see: A Bachelors or advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Business Analytics, or equivalent. Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with object-oriented programming preferred. Excellent knowledge of machine learning algorithms and strong statistical/econometric modeling skills. Ability to query and analyze data from large-scale databases. Prior experience in big data engineering preferred. Experience with data visualization and communicating technical results to a non-technical audience. Familiar with large language model (LLM) frameworks. The ability to work both independently and as a team player. Strong interest or previous experience in finance preferred. Representation at Lazard Lazard is an intellectual capital business committed to delivering the best advice and solutions to clients. To achieve these objectives, we focus on attracting, developing and retaining the best talent. We believe that a workforce comprised of people who represent a wide array of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives creates a rich variety of thought that empowers us to challenge conventional wisdom, solve problems creatively and make better decisions. Lazard was built on the premise that a multicultural firm can best serve a global clientele. As a global firm that has grown organically from local roots in different countries, we have a deep tradition of respecting and appreciating individual differences. Doing so has been core to our success for over 175 years. We are committed to sustaining an environment where every colleague is supported in their professional pursuits, can maximize their individual potential and contribute to our collective success.
